market_name: Lexington, KY visitor market (PetTripFinder discovery scope)

geographic_bounds._disclosure: OBSERVATION box, not an admission boundary. It covers Lexington-Fayette Urban County in full plus the three fringe county seats this order was told to evaluate rather than assume (Georgetown/Scott, Nicholasville/Jessamine, Versailles/Woodford), so that discovery SEES those candidates and this order can classify them on evidence instead of being blind to them. Admission is decided by `included_municipalities`, which today lists Lexington only; every fringe candidate lands OUTSIDE_MARKET unless a founder ruling or the explicit-hotel mechanism admits it. Deliberately excludes Frankfort (-84.87), Winchester (-84.18), Richmond (37.75) and Paris (38.21/-84.25 is the box corner, Paris proper is beyond it): separate county seats and separate lodging destinations, consistent with the Louisville boundary review that excluded Lexington from Louisville as a 'Separate destination'. Not an MSA boundary.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~2 decimal places, roughly 1km) approximate municipal-center and corridor reference points from general public geographic knowledge, rounded deliberately to avoid a false impression of survey-grade precision. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries only. A future sprint should replace them with a cited source (e.g. US Census TIGER/Line places or Lexington-Fayette Urban County open-data GIS) before any precision-dependent use.

_boundary_note: PTF-LEXINGTON-KY-NEW-MARKET-001. Reusable discovery seed only; this order runs no paid provider API. Ten ADMITTING cells cover the Lexington-Fayette Urban County traveler product the order named: downtown, University of Kentucky / medical center, the New Circle Road ring, the I-64/I-75 interchange cluster, Hamburg, the Blue Grass Airport / Keeneland corridor, and the Nicholasville Road south cluster. Three further cells are prefixed `observed-` and carry a non-admitted municipality on purpose: they exist so the three fringe county seats are MEASURED rather than assumed, and `decide_by_market_geography` will return OUTSIDE_MARKET for everything they find because `included_municipalities` names Lexington alone. Promoting one of them is a founder ruling that adds its municipality here, never a silent bounds widening. Registration needs no edit to `market_config._MARKET_FILENAMES`: PTF-MARKET-AUTHORITY-SHARDING-001 added the conventional-filename fallback (`lexington-ky` -> `lexington_ky.json`) precisely so a new market does not conflict with every other market's branch.
scope_disclosure: 13 bounded cells: 10 admitting Lexington-Fayette cells plus 3 observation-only fringe cells. Conservative visitor-product seed, not full-MSA coverage. The Lexington MSA also contains Bourbon, Clark, Madison, Scott, Jessamine and Woodford counties; none of them is admitted by this file.

explicit_hotel_admissions._what_this_is: The explicit-hotel mechanism the order required, so a single legitimate fringe property never becomes a reason to widen a municipality or a ZIP. An entry admits ONE property by identity, with its own evidence, and does not admit its municipality. Empty at authoring time: this order admits no fringe property by exception, and routes every fringe candidate to the founder packet instead.
